@@ -1,52 +0,0 @@
-name: Pages
-
-on:
-  push:
-    branches: [main]

-
-concurrency:
-  group: github-pages
-  cancel-in-progress: true
-
-permissions:
-  contents: read
-  pages: write
-  id-token: write
-
-jobs:
-  build:
-    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
-    steps:
-      - name: Checkout published docs branch
-        uses: actions/checkout@v4
-
-      - name: Setup Bun
-        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
-        with:
-          bun-version: "1.3.13"
-
-      - name: Setup Pages
-        uses: actions/configure-pages@v5
-
-      - name: Install dependencies
-        run: bun install --frozen-lockfile
-
-      - name: Build Antora site
-        run: bun run docs:build
-
-      - name: Upload Pages artifact
-        uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v3
-        with:
-          path: build/site
-
-  deploy:
-    needs: build
-    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
-    environment:
-      name: github-pages
-      url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}
-    steps:
-      - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
-        id: deployment
-        uses: actions/deploy-pages@v4

@@ -260,3 +260,52 @@ jobs:
           git checkout -B main origin/main
           git merge --ff-only "${{ needs.gate.outputs.release_sha }}"
           git push origin main
+
+  pages-build:
+    needs:
+      - gate
+      - promote-main
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    permissions:
+      contents: read
+      pages: write
+      id-token: write
+    steps:
+      - name: Checkout released commit
+        uses: actions/checkout@v4
+        with:
+          fetch-depth: 0
+          ref: ${{ needs.gate.outputs.release_sha }}
+
+      - name: Setup Bun
+        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
+        with:
+          bun-version: ${{ env.BUN_VERSION }}
+
+      - name: Setup Pages
+        uses: actions/configure-pages@v5
+
+      - name: Install dependencies
+        run: bun install --frozen-lockfile
+
+      - name: Build Antora site
+        run: bun run docs:build
+
+      - name: Upload Pages artifact
+        uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v3
+        with:
+          path: build/site
+
+  pages-deploy:
+    needs: pages-build
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    permissions:
+      pages: write
+      id-token: write
+    environment:
+      name: github-pages
+      url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}
+    steps:
+      - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
+        id: deployment
+        uses: actions/deploy-pages@v4
